s1.syndrome_frame: cyanotic congenital heart disease with thrombocytopenia
salient_findings: pulmonary atresia with ventricular septal defect
thrombocytopenia with prolonged platelet aggregation time
key_facts: male newborn with cyanosis at 1 day of age
oxygen saturation 80% in room air
hematocrit 47.8% and platelet count 103 000/mm3 at birth
pulmonary atresia with ventricular septal defect and patent ductus arteriosus on echocardiography
prostaglandin infusion increased oxygen saturation to 90-95%
systemic-to-pulmonary shunt operation performed on day 11
postoperative platelet count increased without transfusion
thrombocytopenia persisted at 10 months of age
normal prothrombin time, activated partial thromboplastin time, and INR
negative antiplatelet antibodies and platelet-associated immunoglobulins
prolonged platelet aggregation time

s4.champion: Pulmonary atresia with ventricular septal defect

raw.champion: Pulmonary atresia with ventricular septal defect
raw.rationale: The patient's echocardiography revealed pulmonary atresia with ventricular septal defect and a patent ductus arteriosus, which is a key finding that explains the cyanosis and low oxygen saturation at birth. The subsequent systemic-to-pulmonary shunt operation and Rastelli operation further support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Glanzmann thrombasthenia
rejected.why: Normal prothrombin time, activated partial thromboplastin time, and INR, and negative antiplatelet antibodies and platelet-associated immunoglobulins do not support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Bernard-Soulier syndrome
rejected.why: Prolonged platelet aggregation time is not specific to this condition and other findings do not support it

rejected.label: Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome
rejected.why: No signs of infection, eczema, or other characteristic features of this syndrome

rejected.label: Congenital amegakaryocytic thrombocytopenia
rejected.why: Platelet count increased without transfusion postoperatively, which is not typical of this condition

rejected.label: Tetralogy of Fallot
rejected.why: Echocardiography showed pulmonary atresia with ventricular septal defect, not tetralogy of Fallot

rejected.label: Tricuspid atresia
rejected.why: Echocardiography did not show tricuspid atresia

rejected.label: Ebstein's anomaly
rejected.why: Echocardiography did not show Ebstein's anomaly
